name: NAND read-recovery controller (virtual IP, transaction level) - specification of the intended (golden) behavior

outputs.state_o: current FSM state (4 bits, one of the 8 states)
outputs.hint_o: 4-bit failure information reported with a NAND failure (read: error-count bucket, program: failing plane)
outputs.err_o: 1-cycle pulse after an unexpected command aborts a recovery in progress (states 1-7); IDLE traffic never raises it
outputs.map_commit_o: 1-cycle pulse: the logical-to-physical map was updated
outputs.map_wr_cnt_o: number of map entries written by that commit

map_protocol.reserve: a relocation target is first reserved in one of two slots (filled in order)
map_protocol.cancel: a failed relocation program cancels its own reservation
map_protocol.rearm: after a verify-read failure is recovered, the rewrite target overwrites the most recent reservation
map_protocol.commit: a commit writes every valid reservation to the map, then clears all reservations
map_protocol.rule: every commit must write exactly one map entry (map_wr_cnt_o == 1)

error_model.lfsr: 16-bit Fibonacci, taps 16/14/13/11, advances 7 steps per accepted transaction (disjoint bits per operation, 7 coprime with period 65535), not cleared by host reset

coverage.states: the 8 states above, plus one spec-violation event: a commit that writes more than one map entry (index 8, observed by the monitor; it is also the scoreboard rule)
coverage.arcs_note: [7,8] = the MAP_PENDING commit that violated the rule; [7,0] = abort or a correct commit
coverage.recovery: ECC_FAIL x hint(16) -> RECOVERED, PGM_FAIL x hint(16) -> RELOCATED, ECC_FAIL2 x hint(16) -> RECOVERED2
coverage.totals: 73 bins = 71 spec-coverage bins + 2 spec-violation bins (state 8, arc [7,8])
